Name: Disk Cleanup
Description: Free disk space by safely removing temporary files, caches, and unused system data.

Params.name: InfoNote
Params.default: Free disk space by safely removing temporary files, caches, and unused system data.

Params.name: TargetDrive
Params.label: Target Drive
Params.description: Drive to clean. Typically C: for system drive.

Params.name: CleanTempFiles
Params.label: Clean Temporary Files
Params.description: Remove files from Windows\Temp and user temp folders.

Params.name: CleanWindowsUpdate
Params.label: Clean Windows Update Cache
Params.description: Clean Windows Update download cache and old update files.

Params.name: CleanRecycleBin
Params.label: Empty Recycle Bin
Params.description: Permanently delete all files in Recycle Bin.

Params.name: CleanBrowserCache
Params.label: Clean Browser Caches
Params.description: Clean cache for Chrome, Edge, Firefox. User must close browsers first.

Params.name: CleanErrorReports
Params.label: Clean Error Reports
Params.description: Remove Windows Error Reporting logs and dumps.

Params.name: CleanOldWindows
Params.label: Clean Windows.old Folder
Params.description: Remove Windows.old folder from previous Windows installation (if exists). WARNING: Cannot undo!

Params.name: CleanDownloads
Params.label: Clean Downloads Folder (30+ days old)
Params.description: Remove files from Downloads folder older than 30 days. Use with caution!

Params.name: DryRun
Params.label: Dry Run (Show what would be cleaned)
Params.description: Scan and report space that would be freed without actually deleting anything.

Params.name: MinFileAge
Params.label: Minimum File Age (days)
Params.description: Only clean temp files older than this many days. 0 = clean all. Recommended: 7 for safety.
